purpose: Collaborative work design and control with an agent
Understanding sufficient for implementation and debugging

progression.newTopic: Brief actual component topology, then the selected action
progression.followUp: Resolve the specific confusion without restarting the whole catalog
progression.expandWhen: User requests parameters, exhaustive lists, failure cases, implementation detail or a material condition requires explanation

terms.meaning: Named callable interface offered to the model; accepts arguments and returns a result.
Operation selector inside one tool, when the schema uses a discriminator.
Value supplied to a tool or function; distinguish required, optional and default values only as relevant.
Function executed inside submitted code; not automatically a separate model-facing tool.
Concrete process/runtime interpreting the submitted code or sending the operation.
Actual browser/window/service/file affected by the operation.
Value or resource retained, changed or recreated across operations/calls.
Returned data or observable effect; distinguish transport success from the intended outcome.

questions: Where does the same operation run?
Can the capability be used under another interface?
Does changing mode affect only newly created agents?
Which exact field contains the code?
Which statements execute in one call?
What is returned to the model?
What output contract and start state are required?
Which boundaries and failures were actually verified?
Is this an example, expected output or actual observation?
Did the tool run in the intended session and target?

boundaries: This reference does not select tools, grant execution permission, register a runtime, call a model or own retries.
During ongoing work, a local explanation preserves the active objective, plan, ownership and completion criteria; it creates no new prerequisite and does not change native Goal state.
Default progressive detail does not suppress a material condition that changes the meaning or side effects of the selected operation.

exampleFormat.toolCall: Use the actual native tool name and argument field from the applicable schema.
exampleFormat.code: A minimal supported-language program using verified helper names.
exampleFormat.output: Clearly label illustrative output separately from actual captured evidence.
